latin: Ita se habet intellectus agens ad producenda intelligibilia in possibilem intellectum, sicut se habet forma artis ad producendas formas in materiam artis.
translation: The agent intellect stands to the producing of intelligibles in the possible intellect just as the form of an art stands to the producing of forms in the matter of that art.
